explication: Clodds is an AI-powered trading terminal for prediction markets, crypto and futures, operated through messaging channels or its WebChat. The principal workflow is a user request entering the gateway, being handled by the agent and its skills, then using market data and opportunity analysis to inform risk checks and execution; portfolio services track resulting positions. The README also describes broad exchange coverage, automation, token security, and Bittensor mining. Connections reflect README statements and available source references; unsampled implementation details are not asserted.
